description: The DERIVED Borromean (Brunnian, irreducible) 3-body cluster c₃^Borr = E₀·(τ_free − τ_Borr) with τ_free = τ(h=0) = 1 (3-unlink) and τ_Borr the GAP-A-4 H₃ Markov-trace closed form (4+h²−3h⁴−h⁶)/(h²+4). Being Brunnian (all 2-sub-links trivial) the pairwise binding vanishes and the whole content is the irreducible 3-body cluster. Closed form 1−τ_Borr = h⁴(3+h²)/(h²+4) ≥ 0 ∀ real h ⇒ c₃^Borr > 0 for q ≠ 1. This POSITIVE sign is the one μ₃ = +0.4708 needs and the one the MULTIPLICATIVE pairwise route provably CANNOT supply (#4354 productModel_3body_nonpos + markovParam_le_half, z ≤ ½ < 1). The Brunnian object is non-multiplicative so its sign is NOT bounded by the z≤½ wall. VERDICT: DERIVED POSITIVE-SIGN LEAD (scope-(a)); 0 free params. NOT a closure — bare-H₃ magnitude ~0.006 MeV ≪ +0.4708/~1.5 MeV target; any tuned level-lift/enhancement would be a FIT, not claimed, not wired. Δ_λ remains open.
